top_signals.title: Keeping America Out: Revisiting China’s Deterrence Strategy for Taiwan
top_signals.summary:
In 2025, Joel Wuthnow wrote “How China Could Counter U.S. Intervention in War Over Taiwan,” arguing that Beijing’s best option might be to deter Washington from coming to Taiwan’s aid by raising the risks to the U.S. homeland. A year and a half later, we asked him to revisit that argument.Image: Lance Cpl. Victor GurrolaIn your 2025 article, you argued that debates over a Taiwan conflict focus too heavily on China striking U.S. forces first, when Beijing’s most attractive option may be keeping the United States out of the fight altogether by threatening the American homeland.
